# cortexcloud_container_registry (Resource)

Manages a third-party container registry connector (CWP Registry Onboarding).

`password` and `auth_token` are never read back from the API. After `terraform import` they are empty in state, so the first apply that sets them sends the full connector again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Onboard a Docker Hub registry connector, scanning via a Cortex-managed
# cloud environment.
resource "cortexcloud_container_registry" "dockerhub" {
  vendor = "DOCKER_HUB"
  name   = "dockerhub-connector"
  url    = "https://registry-1.docker.io"

  username = "svc-account"
  password = var.dockerhub_password

  scanning_mode  = "CLOUD"
  cloud_provider = "AWS"
  region         = "us-east-1"

  initial_scan_configuration = {
    mode     = "TAGS_MODIFIED_DAYS"
    num_days = 30
  }

  docker_hub = {
    repository = "my-org/my-repo"
  }
}

# Onboard a self-hosted Harbor registry, scanning via an Outpost.
resource "cortexcloud_container_registry" "harbor" {
  vendor = "HARBOR"
  name   = "harbor-connector"
  url    = "https://harbor.internal.example.com"

  auth_token = var.harbor_token

  scanning_mode = "OUTPOST"
  outpost_id    = "outpost-1234"

  initial_scan_configuration = {
    mode = "ALL"
  }

  insecure_pull  = false
  ca_certificate = var.harbor_ca_certificate
}

# Scope scanning to a subset of assets using asset_scope_filters.
resource "cortexcloud_container_registry" "gitlab" {
  vendor = "GITLAB_CONTAINER_REGISTRY"
  name   = "gitlab-connector"
  url    = "https://gitlab.example.com"

  auth_token = var.gitlab_token

  scanning_mode  = "CLOUD"
  cloud_provider = "GCP"
  region         = "us-central1"

  initial_scan_configuration = {
    mode = "LATEST_TAG"
  }

  gitlab = {
    group_ids = "123,456"
  }

  filter_type = "EXCLUDE"
  asset_scope_filters = {
    or = [
      {
        search_field = "Registry"
        search_type  = "EQ"
        search_value = "archived/legacy-repo"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `initial_scan_configuration` (Attributes) Which images are scanned when the connector is onboarded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_scan_configuration))
- `name` (String) The name of the registry connector.
- `scanning_mode` (String) Where scanning runs. `CLOUD` requires `cloud_provider` and `region`; `OUTPOST` requires `outpost_id`; `BROKER` requires `broker_type` and `broker_id`.
- `url` (String) The URL of the registry.
- `vendor` (String) The registry vendor. Changing this forces a new connector.

### Optional

- `allow_static_ips` (Boolean) Whether static IP addresses are allowed. Defaults to `false`.
- `asset_scope_filters` (Attributes) Filters that scope which registry assets are scanned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asset_scope_filters))
- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) A token for registry authentication. Never read back from the API.
- `broker_id` (String) The broker ID used for `BROKER` scanning.
- `broker_type` (String) The Broker VM type used for `BROKER` scanning.
- `ca_certificate` (String) A CA certificate used to authenticate the registry.
- `cloud_provider` (String) The Cortex cloud provider used for `CLOUD` scanning.
- `docker_hub` (Attributes) Docker Hub-specific options. Only valid with vendor `DOCKER_HUB`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--docker_hub))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `filter_type` (String) Whether `asset_scope_filters` include or exclude assets. Defaults to `INCLUDE`.
- `gitlab` (Attributes) GitLab-specific options. Only valid with vendor `GITLAB_CONTAINER_REGISTRY`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gitlab))
- `insecure_pull` (Boolean) Allow image pulls from insecure registries. Defaults to `false`.
- `ip_identifier` (String) The identifier associated with the static IP address.
- `openshift` (Attributes) OpenShift-specific options. Only valid with vendor `OPENSHIFT`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--openshift))
- `outpost_id` (String) The outpost ID used for `OUTPOST` scanning. Required when `scanning_mode` is `OUTPOST`. For other scanning modes the API may assign a value, which is then exported here.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password for registry authentication. Never read back from the API.
- `region` (String) The region used for scanning. Choose the region closest to the registry.
- `registry_type` (String) Whether the registry is cloud hosted or self hosted.
- `repository` (String) The repository used for image discovery.
- `username` (String) The username for registry authentication. Must be set together with `password`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The connector ID.
- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant ID the connector belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--initial_scan_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initial_scan_configuration`

Required:

- `mode` (String) `ALL`, `LATEST_TAG` or `TAGS_MODIFIED_DAYS`.

Optional:

- `num_days` (Number) Days (1-90) within which tags must have been modified. Required when `mode` is `TAGS_MODIFIED_DAYS`, and only allowed then.


<a id="nestedatt--asset_scope_filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asset_scope_filters`

Optional:

- `and` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asset_scope_filters--and))
- `or` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asset_scope_filters--or))

<a id="nestedatt--asset_scope_filters--and"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asset_scope_filters.and`

Optional:

- `and` (Attributes List) (same schema as this attribute)
- `or` (Attributes List) (same schema as this attribute)
- `search_field` (String) The field to match on, for example `xdm.asset.name`.
- `search_type` (String) The comparison to apply, for example `EQ`, `CONTAINS`, `JSON_WILDCARD` or `JSON_WILDCARD_NOT`.
- `search_value` (String) The value to compare against.

For most search types this is a plain string. The JSON-valued search types (`JSON_WILDCARD` and `JSON_WILDCARD_NOT`) instead expect a JSON object, which must be supplied using `jsonencode(...)`; the encoded value is sent to the API as native JSON rather than as a quoted string. For example, to match a tag: `search_value = jsonencode({ key = "application", value = "databricks" })`.
